diagnostics.heading: Warnings, skipped titles & errors
diagnostics.scope: Counters describe processed work units; a skipped title can also produce a warning. Each reason is shown once. Earlier saved scan/source warnings remain until a later result replaces them.
diagnostics.retrying: A retry is in progress. Previous issues are not yet confirmed resolved.
diagnostics.unavailable: This job reported counters without recorded details. Specific reasons are unavailable for that attempt; a new run will record them.
diagnostics.truncated: Diagnostic details are limited to 100 entries; additional details were omitted.
diagnostics.indicator.warning: Warnings or skipped work — open activity diagnostics
diagnostics.reason.unresolved: Skipped: no unique, verified TMDB identity could be obtained. Check metadata access and the source title, year and provider IDs.
diagnostics.reason.identityUnavailable: Skipped: the TMDB identity search failed. Check metadata connectivity and credentials, then retry.
diagnostics.reason.sourceUnknown: Source inventory is unknown. Run a full scan after checking the saved source configuration.
diagnostics.reason.sourceStale: Source refresh failed; the last successful inventory is being used. Check connection and access, then scan again.
diagnostics.reason.unidentifiedEpisode: Some source episodes lack a valid season or episode number and were not counted.
diagnostics.reason.invalidRange: An invalid or oversized combined-episode range was reduced to its valid starting episode.
diagnostics.reason.virtualIgnored: Missing or virtual placeholders were ignored; they are not owned media files.
diagnostics.reason.movieUnavailable: Movie metadata could not be loaded. Inventory remains known; retry metadata evaluation.
diagnostics.reason.seriesUnavailable: Series metadata could not be loaded. Owned episodes are retained; retry evaluation.
diagnostics.reason.collectionUnavailable: Collection metadata could not be loaded; collection gaps are unverified.
diagnostics.reason.seasonUnavailable: Season metadata could not be loaded; episode gaps are unverified.
diagnostics.reason.cacheUnavailable: This cache request failed. Check TMDB access and retry cache refresh.
diagnostics.reason.suggestionsUnavailabl: This recommendation request failed. Check metadata access and generate suggestions again.
diagnostics.reason.aiUnavailable: AI recommendations failed. Check the saved AI connection and credentials, then retry.
diagnostics.reason.sourceUnavailable: The source operation failed. Check saved connection, credentials, permissions and source revision.
diagnostics.reason.storageUnavailable: Stored diagnostics or results could not be read/written. Check the persistent data directory, permissions and available storage.
diagnostics.reason.scanFailed: The latest scan failed before successful publication. Check the recorded phase, source connections and storage.
diagnostics.reason.unfinishedScan: An unfinished scan is recorded. A successful new scan is required to replace it.
diagnostics.reason.legacyWarning: An older warning was recorded, but its unstructured content cannot be displayed safely. Run again for structured details.
diagnostics.reason.pendingCatalog: Saved results do not yet match the current inventory or configuration. Wait for recalculation or run a scan.
diagnostics.reason.legacyCatalog: This older result predates the current ownership model. Run a scan to replace it.

settings.reset.title: Danger Zone
settings.reset.hint: Resets only affect waim. No files or media on your servers are ever deleted. Data work and saves must be idle; busy resets are rejected. Nothing is immediately refetched.
settings.reset.metadata.details: Deletes downloaded TMDB responses, derived scan results/history, suggestions and derived title aliases. Keeps configured sources and keys, imported raw inventories and their provider IDs, and virtual collection membership.
settings.reset.media.details: Deletes imported source inventories, scan results/history and suggestions. Keeps configured sources and keys, virtual collection entries and the metadata cache. Source inventories become unknown until a new scan.
settings.reset.factory.details: Deletes all user settings, API credentials, real sources, virtual entries, inventories, metadata cache and derived results. Restores defaults with one enabled empty Virtual collection. Keeps master.key, the database file and the persistent data directory. Resets UI preferences and clears retained activity and logs.
settings.reset.confirm: I understand what will be deleted and retained.
settings.reset.confirmError: Choose a valid reset scope, check the confirmation and type RESET.
settings.reset.busy: Data work, a save or maintenance is in progress. Nothing was reset. Wait until idle and retry.
settings.reset.stale: This page predates a reset or restart. Reload before saving.
settings.reset.failed: Reset could not finish. Check the logs. If factory-reset recovery is pending, data access is blocked; retry the factory reset or restart after fixing the storage problem.
settings.reset.done: Reset completed. No metadata or source inventory was automatically refetched.
activity.heading: Live activity
activity.scope: Independent jobs · progress is per phase
activity.detail.idle: No active work. Runs on demand or when scheduled.
activity.detail.completed: Latest job completed. No active work.
activity.detail.partial: Latest job finished with incomplete or unverified results. See logs for details.
activity.detail.failed: Latest job failed. See logs for details.
activity.detail.cancelled: Latest job stopped before completion or was superseded.

settings.title: Settings
settings.exportsHint: Download your settings (API keys stay encrypted) or the latest sync state as JSON.
settings.tmdbApiKey: API key or read access token
settings.aiHint: Optional remote AI endpoint (OpenAI-compatible, e.g. Azure AI Foundry) used to generate suggestions from your library.
settings.scanHint: When and how waim reads your Jellyfin libraries. Every scan lists the items of the enabled libraries and the episodes of each series.
settings.intervalHint: How often a scan starts automatically. Each scan is one pass over all enabled libraries; 0 means only the "Scan now" button starts one.
settings.includeSpecialsHint: Specials are usually incomplete on TMDB. When off they count neither as gaps nor in the statistics.
settings.tmdbUsageHint: Everything that talks to TMDB: how fast waim is allowed to ask, how much extra detail it collects, and how the local cache is kept fresh.
settings.rateLimitHint: Upper bound for all TMDB calls together (scans, suggestions and the background refresh). TMDB itself allows roughly 50 requests per second; a low value is gentle on the API but makes the first scan slower.
settings.rateEstimate: At most {rps} requests/s ≈ {perMin} per minute ≈ {perHour} per hour.
settings.episodeRatingsHint: Loads every season of every series from TMDB to build the episode rating heatmap and the exact series runtimes. The first scan takes noticeably longer (one request per season); afterwards the responses come from the cache.
settings.cacheHint: TMDB responses are cached locally so scans and suggestions don't reload everything. A background job keeps the cache up to date by refreshing the oldest entries first.
settings.cacheEnabled: Refresh cached TMDB data in the background
settings.cachePercentHint: Each run re-fetches this percentage of the oldest cache entries. The defaults (1% every 15 minutes) spread a full refresh across the day; turn them up to refresh faster or down to ease the load.
settings.cacheEstimate: {entries} cached entries: ≈ {batch} requests every {interval} min (≈ {perHour} per hour), a full refresh every {full}.
settings.cacheEstimateOff: Background refresh is off — cached entries are only renewed by scans and suggestions.
settings.cacheCleanupHint: Once a night (03:00) cache entries that no scan or suggestion has requested for this many days are deleted, clearing data for media removed from your library.
settings.logLevelHint: Controls how verbose the activity log and console output are. Applies immediately on save.
settings.librariesHint: Select which libraries to include in scans.
settings.savedPendingKey: Saved. One connection still needs its API key.
settings.noScript: This page needs JavaScript to save your changes automatically.
settings.connNeedsKey: The address changed. Enter the API key for the new address to reconnect.
settings.connAiDisabled: AI suggestions are off, so nothing is checked.
